title: Rear Admiral Gallaudet researching underwater anomalies

tellings.quote: I know Rear Admiral Tim Galidet uh who used to run uh Noah National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association is highly interested in these underwater anomalies.

plain: A retired Navy rear admiral named Tim Galidet, who once ran NOAA, the US government's ocean and weather agency, is said to be very interested in strange objects seen under water. Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot, tells Michels he knows Galidet and that he is "highly interested in these underwater anomalies", which would mean a former head of an ocean agency is treating the matter seriously.
